title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30129: expose manufacturing cost calculation events
summary: Manufacturing extensions can now separate setup and runtime costs during standard cost calculation by subscribing to new routing, cost-time, direct unit cost, and production order cost events in Calculate Standard Cost and Manufacturing Cost Calculation Management codeunits.
key_points: Added IsHandled routing-line event for SKU calculations in Calculate Standard Cost
Exposed direct unit cost data on post-calculation events
Added IsHandled entry point for expected production-order line costs
Enabled extensions to implement cost-split logic without replacing base objects
Covered both base layer and Italian localization
quote: Manufacturing extensions need separate control over setup and runtime costs so fixed setup costs are not incorrectly spread across varying lot sizes.
